evidence.r1: Light and dark: glass belongs only to navigation, display toggle and purchase configuration; the camera photograph is uncovered content.
evidence.r2: Light and dark: the lens menu replaces its trigger and selected Nickel and lens rows use flat fills.
evidence.r3: Light and dark: five purposeful surfaces provide navigation, display adjustment, body colour, lens and order action.
evidence.r4: Light and dark: all floating surfaces use the same frosted material treatment over the wood photograph.
evidence.r5: Light and dark: no distinct clear-glass variant appears on navigation or purchase controls.
evidence.r6: Light and dark: all configuration and order backgrounds remain neutral rather than carrying saturated action tints.
evidence.r7: Light: wood colour and darker seams visibly affect the navigation, lens menu and purchase surfaces.
evidence.r8: Light and dark: bars use capsules, the display toggle is circular and the lens menu has fixed rounded corners.
evidence.r9: Light and dark: the inset Nickel capsule and selected lens row track their parent curves with consistent gaps.
evidence.r10: Light and dark: navigation, body selection, lens trigger and Order use capsule silhouettes.
evidence.r11: Light and dark: navigation shares one background and the purchase row has three groups for colour, lens and order.
evidence.r12: Light and dark: the icon-only display toggle is separated from text navigation and purchase controls.
evidence.r13: Light and dark: material encloses each complete control, with no separate glass surfaces behind swatches or labels.
evidence.r14: Light and dark: the three purchase groups have intentional equal-looking gaps and a common material.
evidence.r15: Light and dark full captures show only the hero, with no visible scroll-edge treatment at either floating bar.
evidence.r16: Light and dark: wood grain and seams provide varied content behind all floating controls.
evidence.r17: Light and dark resting views: the camera body remains clear of the top navigation and bottom purchase controls.
evidence.r18: Light and dark: bold neutral labels and smaller lens prices retain strong contrast against the frosted surfaces.
evidence.r19: Reduced light: the solid controls remain readable, but increased contrast and reduced motion are not captured.
evidence.r20: Light and dark: the camera photograph fills the window behind both floating control rows.
evidence.r21: Light and dark full captures contain no sensor, lens or price sections, so scrolling content clearance of the bottom bar is not shown.
evidence.r22: Light and dark: navigation and purchase controls float directly on the photograph without an added backing band.
evidence.r23: Light and dark lens-menu endpoints cannot show morphing or pointer-local glow and flex.
evidence.r24: Light and dark: labels and swatches remain neutral while the wood photograph supplies the warm colour.
evidence.r25: Light and dark: black or white labels avoid the orange-brown colours of the underlying wood.
